title: Pricing Desk Memo — Price Protection Scope and Status Window for Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
**Status window.** A price is lowered only while the Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation is in status reserved, awaiting consent, in production or allocated. A fulfilled or cancelled reservation's price is not lowered.

**Types that keep their reserved price.** Launch Pre-Orders and Made-to-Order Reservations keep their reserved price.

**Former clauses.** Two former clauses of the price-protection rule are **no longer in force**, each superseded by the current price-protection basis:

- the clause that the customer pays the lowest regular site price of the reserved SKU between the reservation date and shipment, the reserved unit price being lowered before shipment when the regular price drops;
- the clause that clearance, flash-sale and code-only prices never count and that a price rise never raises the reserved price.

**Status check**

| Reservation status | Price may be lowered |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Yes |
| Awaiting consent | Yes |
| In production | Yes |
| Allocated | Yes |
| Fulfilled | No |
| Cancelled | No |

**Type check**

| Reservation type | Keeps the reserved price under this memo |
|---|---|
| Launch Pre-Order | Yes |
| Made-to-Order Reservation | Yes |

superseded_clauses: Where `price_protection` applies, the customer pays the lowest regular site price of the reserved SKU between the reservation date and shipment (`price_protection_basis`): when the regular price drops, the reserved unit price is lowered before shipment (`price_protection_application`).
Clearance, flash-sale and code-only prices never count, and a price rise never raises the reserved price.
